conf.description: entra-id identity-protection dataset, json format: parsing deferred entirely to the Azure Logs integration (azure.identity_protection data stream). Thin pipeline: filters the shared Event Hub feed to the RiskyUsers/UserRiskEvents categories, decodes the escaped-JSON additionalInfo string the stock pipeline never expands, and tags event.dataset.

conf.comment: entra-id / identity-protection / json: RiskyUsers and UserRiskEvents diagnostic categories on the same Event Hub. Parsing (envelope + source.ip geo enrichment) is left to the Azure Logs integration -- do not re-implement it. additionalInfo arrives as an escaped JSON string the stock pipeline leaves untouched; the field-table transform explicitly instructs decoding it and lifting userAgent/clientIp, so that is done here. properties.riskLevel -> event.severity needs a numeric severity lookup the source map does not specify a scale for (and hidden/none must be excluded rather than defaulted to zero); that mapping is deliberately NOT implemented here and is left to the Elastic-side @custom pipeline -- see README gaps.

functions.description: document scope: thin pass-through, integration owns ECS mapping; note the deferred severity lookup
identify the event: keep only the RiskyUsers/UserRiskEvents categories on this shared Event Hub feed
decode the escaped-JSON additionalInfo string and lift userAgent/clientIp per the field-table transform, and tag event.dataset ahead of the integration's own parsing
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
